piwc_gate.rule_text: Insta-PIWC would be mandatory. Exemption allowed for Keyman, Employer Employee & Defense categories. For combo products and physical proposals, there is no provision for Insta PIWC. Hence, Video MER would be insisted (in addition to the medical as per medical grid).
piwc_gate.fallback_when_no_insta_piwc: Video MER (VMER) mandatory in addition to the medical grid

cibil_gate._source: Explanation on IIB and CIBIL Score rules.msg — 'A. Financial eligibility basis CIBIL Score'
cibil_gate.rule_text: Max SA: INR 2 crores, CIBIL 650 and above with Lower income band INR 5 lakhs. Lower range of CIBIL income estimator is equal to or higher than declared income in proposal form (minimum income INR 5 lakhs). Loan details mandatory.
